text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we need to decide how to bootstrap signed layers for the upcoming base-image rebuild. key-distribution and rollback story still fuzzy.
Mira: Agree, especially around offline signing for air-gapped customers. question: do we require cosign with KMS-backed keys or allow a temporary GPG/ssh fallback?
Devon: Strong +1 for KMS-first (cloud KMS/HSM). fallback complicates provenance and audit. but we need a pragmatic migration path for staging -> prod.
Jamie: Ops and platform both worry about key sprawl. can we use a gateway service that wraps KMS signing and exposes a single service account? that would centralize RBAC.
Alex: Idea: signer-proxy service with limited SA, calls into KMS/HSM. signer-proxy logs attestations to audit-log topic. RBAC: only the pipeline SA can call signer-proxy.
Mira: Sounds good. need to define audit retention and what fields we capture: image digest, builder id, pipeline run id, signed-by key id, cosign output. also capture sbom hash.
sec-bot: created issue SSEC-2142: "design signer-proxy + audit schema" — https://issues.internal/SSEC-2142 :eyes:
Devon: For canary, we should do staging images signed by ephemeral test keys (also KMS) and enforce verification in staging runtime. prod only accepts images signed by prod KMS key.
Jamie: How does rollback work if prod key is compromised or rotated? we need a recovery plan that includes a short-lived grace period and a revocation list check during verification.
Mira: Revocation list can be stored in central datastore and referenced by runtime verifier. verifier checks: cosign verify-predicate && not-in-revocation-list.
Alex: Implementation nit: verification should be pluggable for Dedicated/Private deployments. customers might bring their own KMS; runtime verifier should support key-URI config and optional offline allowlist.
Devon: Also include an automation play: when CVE triggers rebuild, pipeline signs with staging key, run evals, then key ceremony to promote signing to prod key. keep key ceremony logs in KMS audit trivial to trace.
Jamie: Ops: schedule a 2-hour cutover window for the first rollout. Need oncall + sec lead + platform eng. propose Wed 02:00 UTC next week.
Mira: Add checklist items: 1) deploy signer-proxy in staging, 2) integrate cosign in CI, 3) push SBOMs to artifact-registry, 4) enable runtime verifier gate in staging, 5) run 2-week canary, 6) promote keys with documented KMS rotation step.
Alex: Example verification command for QA:
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/ci-sign-key \
  gcr.io/redwood/base:2026.03.21
```
Devon: QA note: for private deployments where k8s:// URI isn't allowed, use cosign with a signed certificate bundle and set COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 for attestation flow. document both flows.
Jamie: Rollback trigger conditions: failing smoke tests post-deploy, elevated error rate >0.5% on inference path, or signature verification regression. rollback path: disable route to new pool and mark key revoked until investigation.
Mira: One open question — do we require SBOM-attestation pairing in verification (i.e., require both signature and SBOM hash match)? I vote yes for prod.
Alex: +1 for prod, optional for staging. need to update runtime error messages so operators know signature vs sbom failures.
sec-bot: incident stub created: SSEC-rollback-template added to runbook under incidents/ (auto)
Devon: I'll draft the signer-proxy spec and RBAC matrix (who can call, who can approve key promotion). will post PR by EOD.
Alex: Thanks team — good plan. we'll reconvene after PR and lock the rollout window. :thumbsup:
